title: Baselines
intro: A baseline is a named, frozen copy of the plan: every milestone's dates, estimate and team, and every project's span, rank and target window; since version 1.26 also every dependency link and every team's capacity periods (an older baseline holds neither). Compare one with the plan as it is now. Everyone can read baselines; administrators and roadmap editors take, rename and delete them.
takeIntro: Copies the plan as it is now, with its links and every team's capacity. The copy cannot be changed afterwards; the holiday calendar and the teams' own order are not part of it.
capReached: The limit of {{max}} baselines is reached: delete one first
emptyHint: Take a baseline to freeze the plan as it is now, then compare it later.
emptyHintReadOnly: Administrators and roadmap editors take baselines.
saveConflict: A baseline with this name already exists
saveForbidden: Only administrators and roadmap editors can change baselines
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This baseline no longer exists — the list was reloaded

validation.descriptionLength: Description must be at most 500 characters

deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its name becomes free again, and a page that had it picked falls back to no baseline.
deleteForbidden: Only administrators and roadmap editors can delete baselines
deleteGone: This baseline was already deleted — the list was reloaded

compare.title: Baseline
compare.notFound: This baseline does not exist (or was deleted).
compare.samePlan: The plan has not changed since this baseline.
compare.samePlanCapacity: The plan has not moved since this baseline; the capacity has changed.
compare.changesIntro: Only rows that changed are listed. Start and end are in working days on the current calendar; a positive figure means later.
compare.sameRevision: The two baselines are at the same plan revision: nothing moved.
compare.changesIntroAgainst: Only rows that changed between the two baselines are listed. Start and end are in working days on the current calendar; a positive figure means later in "{{now}}" than in "{{then}}".

against.label: Compare against
against.unavailable: The list of baselines could not be loaded; only the live plan is available.
against.dropped: The baseline you compared against no longer exists; showing the comparison with the live plan instead.

links.title: Links
links.intro: Links are matched one by one: a link whose type or lag differs is changed, and one deleted and made again counts as removed and added. Only changed links are listed.
links.notCaptured: This baseline was taken before baselines froze links, so nothing can be said about them. That is not the same as no changes.
links.notCapturedAgainst: One of the two baselines was taken before baselines froze links, so nothing can be said about them. That is not the same as no changes.
links.truncated: More links changed than fit here: the first {{count}} by id are listed, and the totals count them all.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.intro: The date ranges on which a team's capacity (man-days per week and WIP limit) differs. Splitting a period into two equal ones is no change. Only teams whose capacity differs are listed.
capacity.notCaptured: This baseline was taken before baselines froze capacity, so nothing can be said about it. That is not the same as no changes.
capacity.notCapturedAgainst: One of the two baselines was taken before baselines froze capacity, so nothing can be said about it. That is not the same as no changes.
capacity.truncated: More capacity changes than fit here: the first {{count}} are listed (the last team may be cut), and the totals count every team.
